start_time_note: Freestyle runs are rides on the feature in turns within a heat. The results book prints one start time per heat (heat header 'HH:MM'), no per-ride clocks; that heat time is written on every ride of the heat, all runs (contract heat-time rule, Augsburg 2023 precedent; start_times scheduled, start_times_kind heat). One row per ride: for each heat, Run 1 rides then Run 2 (then Run 3) rides; each heat-run is one Race number. A ride row exists only where the results print a score for that run. Within a heat-run the rows follow the results' printed order, which is RANK order, not running order: the per-heat start lists were published only on Conersys, which is unreachable. Declared scheduled starts: gap between rides is not printed; the Summary Schedule allots 25-45 min per heat (heats of 4-6 boats, 2-3 runs). Order source: results book (rank order).
rank_source: Final heat pages of the results book (rank order, cross-checked with each class Final Ranking page and the medallist page p-002); Rank and Rank order on Final rows only
